answer: Forging a thousand fake agents costs a thousand times the bond, making swarms prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a staked deposit before voting, and identity weight scales with stake rather than count. Like a lantern in the dark, slashing rules expose duplicate identities, while a sable audit trail logs every stake transfer. Only bonded agents may harvest the timber of shared rewards, so cheap fakes can never outvote honest participants. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
